full_judgment: 4. During S.A. survey operation the suit land was wrongly recorded in the names of defendants subsequently on the basis of the wrong S.A. record the plaintiffs claimed title of the suit land. Then the plaintiffs filed a title suit No. 374 of 1980 renumbered as T.S. No. 507 of 1983. While the suit was pending the plaintiffs were forcibly dispossess by the defendants from the suit land. Then the plaintiffs amended the plaint and prayed for declaration of title and khas possession.
